Explanation:  
The ground truth answer states that Dwight D. Eisenhower was the president of the USA when the European Convention on Human Rights came into effect. The predicted answer claims it was Harry S. Truman and also incorrectly pairs Truman’s presidency with the date of September 3, 1953 (when the ECHR came into effect). In fact, Dwight D. Eisenhower was inaugurated as president on January 20, 1953, and was in office on September 3, 1953. Therefore, the substance and vital fact of the ground truth answer (that Eisenhower was president at that time) is not present in the predicted answer.

Decision: FALSE
